title: Job Application for Software Engineer II, Developer Portal (New Grad / Early Career) at ID.me
content:
This is a backend-leaning full-stack role. You'll work on the services, APIs, and data models behind the portal (application registration, authorization, and the developer-facing APIs our customers integrate against), and you'll ship the user-facing surfaces those services power in our Next.js and React frontend. You'll start with well-scoped features alongside senior engineers and grow quickly into owning features end-to-end, from API contract to production. [...] Design, implement, test, and deploy Developer Portal capabilities across the stack: backend APIs, database changes, and the frontend experiences customers use. Start with well-defined features and bugs, then take on progressively larger and more ambiguous work as you grow.

### Write High-Quality, Well-Tested Code [...] Our backend services are primarily Java (Spring Boot) alongside legacy Ruby services. The frontend is a micro-frontend platform built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. You don't need to know all of these on day one. If your fundamentals are strong, we're confident you'll pick up whatever the problem requires.

title: Job Application for Software Engineer, Backend at Robinhood
content:
As a Software Engineer, you’ll build and own backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s core financial products. You’ll solve complex scalability challenges while gaining deep expertise in U.S. financial systems and making a direct impact on the products used by millions.
